propositions: rebar doctor lacks read-only lock health visibility: operators cannot inspect held lock holders, holder process liveness, hold duration, or staleness without manual filesystem inspection

A shared lock-health diagnostic surface must report four lock legs (tickets-write fcntl, tickets-write mkdir, hlc fcntl, enrich-drain O_EXCL) with state and metadata: held/free/absent, v2 owner stamp fields, same-host-only holder liveness, hold age, and staleness determination
Doctor lock health must reuse existing primitives (write_lock_is_busy probe, v2 stamp decode, liveness verdict, age calculation, staleness authority) without inventing new heuristics or duplication
A stale lock (determined only via lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale) produces a finding and exit code 1; a held lock with a live holder produces no finding and exit 0; doctor never mutates lock state
Lock results must not join the repair loop so --repair never touches locks; JSON output gains locks and lock_findings keys conforming to updated doctor.schema.json
